qs_1.text: You're working longer. Pushing harder. Doing more of what used to work. And somehow, you're sinking.

qs_2.text: Michael Tiger calls it the Quicksand Effect. Go ahead. Fight it. Move fast, and watch what happens.

qs_3.text: Now stop. Be still. Fighting harder is exactly the wrong move. Sometimes you have to change how you're thinking, and how you're moving.

pi_1.text: The research points to two things future leaders will need most. Adaptability, and resilience. Michael added a third, to hold them together. Authenticity.

pi_2.text: They only work together. Pull one out, and watch what breaks.

li_1.text: LIFE is how inspiration becomes action. Learn. Inspire. Frame. Execute. Here's how one leader used it.

li_2.text: Same team. Same pressure. A different frame. And it worked.

ck_1.text: Nine quick questions. Answer honestly. You'll see your strongest pillar, and the one to work on next.

ck_2.text: The world of leadership is changing fast. If you're feeling overwhelmed, you are not alone. Inspired by LIFE. Available now.
